## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue.

## Changes

Explain the decisions a reviewer needs to assess. Include screenshots for UI changes and sanitized endpoint details
for compatibility changes.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant tests or manual checks described below
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior changed

For host/command changes, include real VS Code smoke-test results. For dependency changes, regenerate third-party
notices and explain why the dependency is needed. Do not include credentials or confidential data.
